name: Dzheyn Termiya
source:
Jane is the daughter of [url=https://vndb.org/c152948]Artemis[/url]. We recently met, and I don’t know much about her yet. [url=https://vndb.org/c144570]Ophelia[/url] told me that Jane is the best assassin of all. At first glance, she made a strong impression on [url=https://vndb.org/c144566]me[/url], and I have a feeling she feels the same way.
